# Cantiere offline image-label post-processing

A dependency-free Dart processing module adapted from the Cantiere Android
local image category classifier. The exact pinned native Android ML Kit bridge,
Dart host service, and Flutter tests are retained under `reference/`.

The **runnable Dart API processes labels**, not photographs. The Android native
bridge is present for provenance, not installed as a plugin.

Usage (after adding this package as a Dart dependency):

```dart
import 'package:cantiere_local_image_labels/local_image_labels.dart';
final summary = LocalImageLabelProcessor.fromNative([
  {'label': 'Apple', 'confidence': 0.92},
]);
print(summary.text);
```

Verification:

```sh
dart pub get --offline
dart analyze lib tool
dart run tool/self_test.dart
```

The real Cantiere MethodChannel is `com.aiorchestrator/local_image_vision`,
method `labelImage`, with the ML Kit image-labeling library 17.0.9. The host
must separately provide actual native inference, file size (8 MiB), RAM
budget, permissions, and timeout checks.

Source-only experimental package, *not* a full image recognizer, deployable
Flutter plugin, production release or proof on a Galaxy S24 FE.

name: cantiere_local_image_labels
version: 0.1.0
description: Offline category label post-processing from the Aivexus Cantiere
publish_to: none
environment:
  sdk: '>=3.4.0 <4.0.0'

requirements.description: Flutter MethodChannel host Flutter version (optional Android native integration)
Google ML Kit image-labeling 17.0.9 (optional Android native backend only)
Isolated internal tests only. No production, release, redistribution, or automatic privileged execution; license and security certification pending.
Existing app must still explicitly provide the native ML Kit classifier and follow platform-specific packaging policy.
No automatic production module installation, redistribution or security approval.
No physical S24 FE result or Android integration validation from this package.
Only pure Dart post-processing is standalone and testable on Linux; Android Kotlin bridge and Flutter app service are source references that cannot compile independently.
Output is image category labels, NOT image description, OCR, object counts, colors, text or multimodal LLM inference.
